properties.holds: Terminal 3 with both piers, the forecourt with the arrival and departure roads, the Airport Express station, IGI Airport T3 Road and the freight terminal. Aerocity is not inside: at true scale it would land on the Vasant Kunj malls (measured in P1-008), so it is left to the airport road corridor
properties.edges: west: the tips of the international and domestic piers; south: just north of runway 11L/29R; east: the end of IGI Airport T3 Road past the freight terminal; north: the Terminal 2 roads, south of runway 10/28
properties.drawn: waypoints picked by hand at junctions and edges read from OpenStreetMap by Overpass (osmBase 2026-11-11T16:40 to 16:56Z); straight lines between them, counter-clockwise, closed. A compact outline: a far block sits at half its real distance from India Gate but is true scale inside, so it must stay small enough to keep clear of its neighbours (rule R-STITCH-05). The production outline follows the real roads when the block is baked (P8)
